final: WITH project_counts AS (SELECT q.arcref, p.fundflux, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM scanqc AS q JOIN projects AS p ON q.arcref = p.arcregistry COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY q.arcref, p.fundflux), funding_sums AS (SELECT fundflux, SUM(record_count) AS count_sum FROM project_counts GROUP BY fundflux), totals AS (SELECT SUM(count_sum) AS total FROM funding_sums) SELECT f.fundflux, f.count_sum, CAST(f.count_sum AS REAL) / t.total FROM funding_sums AS f JOIN totals AS t ON t.total IS NOT NULL
